notes: AHR Expo 2026 took place February 2-4, 2026 at Las Vegas Convention Center with 1,800+ exhibitors and 50,000+ attendees. The official exhibitor list PDF dated 3/20/26 was accessed showing hundreds of confirmed exhibitors. Focus was placed on companies matching InstaLILY's ICP: HVAC equipment manufacturers, distributors with multi-location operations, building automation providers, field service organizations, and commercial equipment suppliers. Major distributors like Watsco (670+ locations, $6B+ revenue), Ferguson (131+ HVAC locations), Winsupply, and Johnstone Supply (410+ locations) are prime targets given their scale, technology investments, and multi-branch operations. OEMs like Johnson Controls, Carrier, Trane, Rheem, and Lennox have large field service operations and complex quoting/parts workflows. ServiceTitan's presence indicates field service software providers are also exhibiting. All companies identified have characteristics matching InstaLILY's ideal customer profile: multi-location operations, legacy ERP systems, high-volume SKU catalogs, sales teams doing manual work, and pressure to scale efficiently.
